description: Shared test vectors for verbatim quotation matching (T04 R[1]). hub/rules (quote@1, quoteMatches in text.ts) and hub/refs (quoteMatches in quote.ts) must both pass every vector; each package reads this file in its tests and cross-check their independent implementations.
rule: The quote must be an exact contiguous substring of the decoded fragment text. Case, punctuation, character width, Unicode normalization form and every whitespace character are significant; no trimming, folding or normalization is applied. Empty and whitespace-only quotes never match.

vectors.note: Latin word boundaries cannot disappear
an extra space between Latin symbols still differs
plain substring
vectors.fragment: 点击登录按钮后，页面跳转到首页。

vectors.note: quote equals the fragment
runs of spaces and a line break do not become single spaces
leading and trailing white space in the quote is significant
a quote may start inside the fragment without including its surrounding text
tab and CRLF do not become spaces
vertical tab does not become a space
a line break inside Chinese text does not match one space
Chinese line breaks are not removed beside wide characters
an extra space beside a wide character is not removed
case stays significant
full-width and half-width punctuation differ
normalization form stays significant (composed against decomposed)
an empty quote never matches
a quote of white space only never matches
empty fragment
quote longer than the fragment
ideographic space U+3000 does not become an ASCII space
no-break space U+00A0 does not become an ASCII space
next line U+0085 does not become an ASCII space
line separator U+2028 does not become an ASCII space
narrow no-break space U+202F does not become an ASCII space
byte order mark U+FEFF is not white space
zero width space U+200B is not white space
Mongolian vowel separator U+180E is not white space
information separator U+001C is not white space
characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane
an exact tab matches
an exact LF matches
an exact CRLF matches
an exact no-break space matches
an exact ideographic space matches
whitespace adjacent to a fullwidth character cannot be deleted
a whitespace-only quote never matches even the same whitespace-only fragment
